E1_SEPARATE_ENV.title: Step away from your current environment
E1_SEPARATE_ENV.description: Reduce sensory overload by leaving the current source of stimulation.
steps: Tell yourself: I need to step back a little to steady myself
Leave the source of stress if you can
Plant both feet on the ground
Breathe in for 4 seconds, out for 6 seconds, repeat 5 times
safetyNotes: This is an immediate support tool, not a substitute for medical care
If you feel at risk of self-harm, contact emergency support right away
E1_SEPARATE_ENV.objective: Create a safe distance so your body can slow down before continuing to handle the situation.
benefits: Reduces the intensity of stimulation right away
Helps your body regain a sense of safety
Creates a pause before reacting further
preparation: Find a quieter corner or leave the situation if you can
Put your phone down or reduce surrounding stimulation
E1_SEPARATE_ENV.quote: You don't have to solve everything right now. Steadying yourself first is the first step.

E2_DEEP_BREATHING.title: Deep breathing
E2_DEEP_BREATHING.description: A short breathing exercise that activates your parasympathetic nervous system.
steps: Place your hand on your belly
safetyNotes: If you feel dizzy, slow down or stop
If you're experiencing acute breathing difficulty, seek medical help
E2_DEEP_BREATHING.objective: Use a steady breathing rhythm to lower your body's alarm response and reduce panic intensity.
benefits: Increases your sense of control over your body
preparation: Find a stable place to sit or stand
Relax your shoulders and jaw before starting
E2_DEEP_BREATHING.quote: Just one deep enough breath can open up more space for your body to calm down.

E4_SLOW_SPEAKING.title: Mindfully slow down your speech
E4_SLOW_SPEAKING.description: Regulate your breathing by slowing down how you speak.
steps: Notice your breathing as you speak
safetyNotes: If you're in a heated argument, prioritize stepping away from the situation first
E4_SLOW_SPEAKING.objective: Slow down your reaction speed so your body and speech can slow down together.
benefits: Creates more time to think before reacting
preparation: Plant both feet firmly on the ground
Take a deep breath before you start speaking
E4_SLOW_SPEAKING.quote: When speech slows down, the body gets a chance to slow down too.
